---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new section, page, or enhancement for the website
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

A brief one-line description of the feature.

## Problem It Solves

What problem or gap does this feature address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you have in mind. Include mockups, wireframes, or
reference designs if available.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Any other context, screenshots, or examples from other websites.

## Priority

- [ ] Critical — blocking business use
- [ ] High — significant improvement
- [ ] Medium — nice to have
- [ ] Low — minor enhancement
